title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the ratio of intensities must be correctly stated as R = 0.02.

title: Use of Fresnel's Equation
description: Important Criteria: The application of Fresnel's equations must be correctly identified and utilized in the solution.

title: Correct Indices of Refraction
description: Important Criteria: The indices of refraction for air (n1) and water (n2) must be correctly identified as n1 = 1 and n2 = 1.33.

title: Mathematical Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the intensity ratio using the formula must be shown with correct arithmetic.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response should include a check for unit consistency in the context of intensity ratios.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect application of the formula that leads to an incorrect final answer will result in a deduction.
